Frontend: DDT field, admin login, tabs, PDF download, notion-exits toggle (475 rows), DDT filter reduce-to-zero all work. ui_bugs.issue: Pressing 'Pulisci' does not restore the unfiltered list. After applying a filter that yields 0 rows and clicking 'Pulisci', Spedizioni App still shows 0. Root cause: clearFilters calls setFCliente('') etc then setTimeout(()=>loadLocal(),0). loadLocal is a closure captured from the previous render, so it reads the OLD filter state (fCliente still='ZZZ...'). React re-render happens before setTimeout, but the loadLocal reference inside the setTimeout is the stale one. Fix: pass the empty values explicitly to a helper, or use useEffect on filter state, or call loadLocalWith({cliente:'',...}).

Scanner dialog displays 'Errore inizializzazione scanner: sconosciuto' on every open (verified across 3 open/close cycles) in headless/browser test. new Html5Qrcode(id) is throwing but with no message. Likely the Radix Dialog portal has not yet inserted the target div id=barcode-scanner-region-N into the DOM when the useEffect runs (portal children mount happens in a microtask on some Radix versions). Recommend: defer constructor with a short setTimeout / requestAnimationFrame, or wait for document.getElementById(containerIdRef.current) to exist before constructing. Note: NO uncaught console errors were thrown — the refactor DID succeed at preventing 'Cannot transition to a new state' errors and unhandled rejections. This is only a UX degradation (generic error text).

action_items: Fix HistoryTab.clearFilters — replace setTimeout(loadLocal, 0) with an approach that reads the reset values. Simplest: pass explicit params like loadLocal({cliente:'', materiale:'', ddt:'', from:'', to:''}) and refactor loadLocal to accept overrides, OR add a useEffect on filter state that debounces load, OR call loadLocal after state resets via a ref.
